name: Cham cheo
summary: Chẩm chéo is the dip Hải Vân builds after buying mắc khén at Phố Đoàn: toasted seed, fresh chili, ginger, salt, and herbs, then more mắc khén stirred in. It is eaten with the meat, especially boiled Cổ Lũng duck. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: Hải Vân, Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 16 May 2022.
taste: That article says the dip goes with boiled, roasted, and grilled meat.
howToEat: As a dip, not a plate on its own in that article.
Pound toasted mắc khén with fresh chili, ginger, salt, rau thơm, húng, mùi tàu, and rau mùi ta, then stir in more mắc khén.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The seed is bought at Phố Đoàn. The dip is eaten at the meal.
seoTitle: Cham cheo in Pu Luong — dip for Co Lung duck
seoDescription: Chẩm chéo is mắc khén, fresh chili, ginger, salt, and herbs, for boiled Cổ Lũng duck. The price is Check on arrival.
